S.FORM: Tonghwa Taise I tini i Cihak ko picodadan. O sadadahalay a picodadan i Taywan . Makapah ko sinari no picodadan. Ira ko lotok i saetipan, ira ko tarawadaw i sawalian, ira ko 'akay a riyar i sa'amisan, ira ko dahetal i satimolay.
S.PHON: to~uŋħwa taisə i tini i ʦiħak ko~u piʦo~uɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮan. o~u saɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮaħaɾaj a piʦo~uɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮan i tajwan . makapaħ ko~u sinari no~u piʦo~uɬ~ɮaɬ~ɮan. ira ko~u ɾo~uto~uk i saətipan, ira ko~u tarawaɬ~ɮaw i sawaɾian, ira ko~u ʡakaj a rijar i saʡamisan, ira ko~u ɬ~ɮaħətaɾ i satimo~uɾaj.
